project_type: Static HTML product page for MiAction insurance product
verification_instructions: Open the generated index.html file and verify: 1) All tabs work, 2) Calculator produces correct results matching the benefit percentages, 3) WhatsApp links work, 4) Responsive on mobile, 5) All content is in Indonesian
setup_instructions: No setup needed - create a single HTML file
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external packages, CDNs, or fonts. Everything must be self-contained in one HTML file.
contribution_requirements: Single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript. No external dependencies.
key_patterns: Template uses: sticky WA banner top, green Manulife theme (#00a758/#006838), tab navigation with data-tab attributes, card-based layout, calc-tabs for calculator sub-sections, FAQ accordion with open/close toggle, floating WA button bottom-right, responsive design with media queries
directory_structure: Single directory with XLSX/PDF source files and the template HTML. Output will be index.html in the same directory.
